stories.title: Three people found dead after Elloree boarding home fire, coroner says
stories.summary: Three people were found dead inside an Elloree boarding home after a fire Friday morning. SLED is helping investigate, and the victims haven’t been identified.

stories.title: Two die after pickup truck runs off I-26, hits tree in Newberry County, troopers say
stories.summary: The Dodge Ram caught fire after hitting a tree near the Jalapa Road exit Thursday afternoon. The crash backed up eastbound traffic past the exit.

stories.title: Pedestrian dies after hit-and-run at Farrow and Hardscrabble roads in Richland County, troopers say
stories.summary: A pickup truck and a second vehicle hit the pedestrian early Friday on Farrow Road. The driver of the second vehicle left the scene, troopers said.

stories.title: Lower Richland odor came from a sewer overflow near Garners Ferry Road apartments, officials say
stories.summary: Columbia Water says it sent crews to the overflow near Colonial Pointe Apartments late Thursday. The cause is still under investigation.

stories.title: Former Sumter pastor charged with breach of trust over church credit card spending, police say
stories.summary: Police say records show at least $13,000 in personal purchases on Northside Memorial Baptist Church’s credit card during his tenure.

stories.title: Man accused of showing gun to Gaston police chief, leading to hourslong Highway 321 standoff
stories.summary: Deputies negotiated for almost two hours before Donald Joseph Ryan Jr. stepped out of his car and they arrested him, the sheriff said.

stories.title: Crews respond to home fire on Still House Road in Camden, Kershaw County officials say
stories.summary: Kershaw County Fire Service, EMS and Camden firefighters are on scene Friday evening. Officials are asking people to use caution in the area.

stories.title: Orangeburg County pedestrian dies after being hit on Highway 178 at Hampton Drive, troopers say
stories.summary: A westbound Nissan Kicks hit the pedestrian around 6 a.m. Friday. The driver was not hurt, the Highway Patrol said.

stories.title: Lower Richland neighbors describe sewer overflow smell as questions about the cause remain
stories.summary: “It stinks worse up here,” one neighbor says. Columbia Water hasn’t said how long sewage overflowed or whether nearby water could be affected.

stories.title: Former Gamecock MiLaysia Fulwiley arrested after Baton Rouge traffic stop, faces 5 charges
stories.summary: The Columbia native, now at LSU, is held on a $20,000 bond. A since-deleted post on what appears to be her account denies hitting an officer.

stories.title: Irmo cancels Christmas parade but tree lighting still on, officials say
stories.summary: The parade had been set for Dec. 5. The town’s free tree lighting is Dec. 1 at Whitt Cline Community Park, with Santa, crafts and treats.

stories.title: Orangeburg man pleads guilty to federal gun charge after trailer theft attempt in Lexington County
stories.summary: He was arrested hours after federal prosecutors met with Lexington County deputies about gun cases. He’d been out of custody only since May.
